comment:
* IkeMessage represents an IKE message. * *

It contains all attributes and provides methods for encoding, decoding, encrypting and * decrypting. * * @see RFC 7296, Internet Key Exchange * Protocol Version 2 (IKEv2)

variables.name: TRUST_MANAGER_PROVIDER
variables.comment: Currently use HarmonyJSSE as TrustManager provider

variables.name: REPEATABLE_PAYLOAD_TYPES
variables.comment: payload types can be included at most once.

variables.name: DECODE_STATUS_OK
variables.comment:
* Represents a message that has been successfully (decrypted and) decoded or reassembled from
     * IKE fragments

variables.name: DECODE_STATUS_PARTIAL
variables.comment: Represents that reassembly process of IKE fragments has started but has not finished

variables.name: DECODE_STATUS_PROTECTED_ERROR
variables.comment: Represents a crypto protected message with correct message ID but has parsing error.

variables.name: DECODE_STATUS_UNPROTECTED_ERROR
variables.comment:
* Represents an unencrypted message with parsing error, an encrypted message with
     * authentication or decryption error, or any message with wrong message ID.

methods.name: public static Provider getTrustManagerProvider()
methods.comment:
* Get security provider for X509TrustManager to do certificate validation. * *

Use JSSEProvdier as the default security provider. * * @return the provider for X509TrustManager

methods.name: public static DecodeResult decode(int expectedMsgId, IkeHeader header, byte[] inputPacket)
methods.comment:
* Decode unencrypted IKE message body and create an instance of IkeMessage. * *

This method catches all RuntimeException during decoding incoming IKE packet. * * @param expectedMsgId the expected message ID to validate against. * @param header the IKE header that is decoded but not validated. * @param inputPacket the byte array contains the whole IKE message. * @return the decoding result.

methods.name: public static DecodeResult decode(int expectedMsgId, @Nullable IkeMacIntegrity integrityMac, IkeCipher decryptCipher, IkeSaRecord ikeSaRecord, IkeHeader ikeHeader, byte[] packet, DecodeResultPartial collectedFragments)
methods.comment:
* Decrypt and decode encrypted IKE message body and create an instance of IkeMessage.
     *
     * @param expectedMsgId the expected message ID to validate against.
     * @param integrityMac the negotiated integrity algorithm.
     * @param decryptCipher the negotiated encryption algorithm.
     * @param ikeSaRecord ikeSaRecord where this packet is sent on.
     * @param ikeHeader header of IKE packet.
     * @param packet IKE packet as a byte array.
     * @param collectedFragments previously received IKE fragments.
     * @return the decoding result.

methods.comment:
* Encode unencrypted IKE message.
     *
     * @return encoded IKE message in byte array.

methods.comment:
* Encrypt and encode packet.
     *
     * @param integrityMac the negotiated integrity algorithm.
     * @param encryptCipher the negotiated encryption algortihm.
     * @param ikeSaRecord the ikeSaRecord where this packet is sent on.
     * @param supportFragment if IKE fragmentation is supported
     * @param fragSize the maximum size of IKE fragment

methods.name: private byte[] encodePayloads()
methods.comment:
* Encode all payloads to a byte array.
     *
     * @return byte array contains all encoded payloads

methods.name: public List<T> getPayloadListForType(@IkePayload.PayloadType int payloadType, Class<T> payloadClass)
methods.comment:
* Obtain all payloads with input payload type. * *

This method can be only applied to the payload types that can be included multiple times * within an IKE message. * * @param payloadType the payloadType to look for. * @param payloadClass the class of the desired payloads. * @return a list of IkePayloads with the payloadType.

methods.name: public T getPayloadForType(@IkePayload.PayloadType int payloadType, Class<T> payloadClass)
methods.comment:
* Obtain the payload with the input payload type. * *

This method can be only applied to the payload type that can be included at most once * within an IKE message. * * @param payloadType the payloadType to look for. * @param payloadClass the class of the desired payload. * @return the IkePayload with the payloadType.

methods.name: public boolean hasNotifyPayload(@NotifyType int notifyType)
methods.comment: Returns if a notification payload with a specified type is included in this message.

methods.name: public boolean isDpdRequest()
methods.comment:
* Checks if this Request IkeMessage was a DPD message * *

An IKE message is a DPD request iff the message was encrypted (has a SK payload) and there * were no payloads within the SK payload (or outside the SK payload).

methods.name: public static String getIkeExchangeSubTypeString(@IkeExchangeSubType int exchangeSubtype)
methods.comment: Returns the exchange sub type as a String

methods.name: public int getIkeExchangeSubType()
methods.comment:
* Gets IKE exchange subtype of an inbound IKE request message. * *

It is not allowed to obtain exchange subtype from an inbound response message for two * reasons. Firstly, the exchange subtype of a response message is the same with its * corresponding request message. Secondly, trying to get the exchange subtype from a response * message will easily fail when the response message contains only error notification payloads.
